subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into the current sub-agent guidance surfaces, or paused because current main already covers the intended delegation behavior?
rationale: The unresolved choice is model-facing prompt policy and nested sub-agent semantics, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not choose that product direction.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
options.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only useful examples into the existing Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, or delegation-mode guidance so there is one availability- and depth-aware policy source.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want to forbid nested sub-agents, change runtime depth behavior, config schema/help, docs, and tests in the same PR.

options.title: Pause As Covered
options.body: If current main's guidance is enough, leave or close this protected branch by maintainer decision without carrying the stale prompt rubric forward.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Prompt Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the stale branch and merge only useful examples into the existing Tooling, Messaging, tool-description, or delegation-mode guidance so there is one availability- and depth-aware policy source.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest current-main ownership signal for the affected prompt and sub-agent prompt files points to peterdsp's commit.
